subject.title: fix(proxy): add error handler on upstream response stream

question: Should maintainers refresh this external PR in place, ask the author to rebase it, or keep it paused until the conflict is resolved?
rationale: The fix direction is sound, but the live branch is dirty against current proxy-capture code and conflict resolution must preserve current body-preview capture behavior.

options.title: Refresh or port in place
options.body: Apply the same upstream response error handler onto current main, preserve current capture helpers/tests, and continue review from the refreshed head.

options.title: Ask author to rebase
options.body: Leave the PR open and wait for the contributor to refresh the branch and rerun focused validation.

options.title: Keep paused
options.body: Do not merge until the conflict is resolved and the observable abort behavior is restated in the test or PR body.

recommendation.title: Refresh or port in place
recommendation.body: Apply the same upstream response error handler onto current main, preserve current capture helpers/tests, and continue review from the refreshed head.
